name: Runner Extras - TestPage Precompiled Declared Editable
brief: Proves a field control's declared Editable/Enabled is honoured on a page that ships PRECOMPILED in a dependency .app, instead of answering the AL default of true for every control (issue #3504).
description: Regression test for RunnerPageInstance answering Editable() = true on every control of every precompiled-dependency page. DependencyPageMetadataXml reconstructs no control tree — right for a control's VALUE BINDING, which lives in the .app's IL — so ControlDefinition(id) was null and EvaluateProperty's 'raw is null => the AL declared none' arm returned the AL default. The declared string is stated per control by the dependency's own SymbolReference.json, the same file GetPageControlFieldMap already reads, and RunnerPageInstance now falls back to it when the runtime tree has no definition. This suite's dependency 'TPCD Precompiled Control Dep' ships page 65601 as pure compiled code (no AL source reachable at runtime); its symbol file declares Editable = false and Enabled = false on the 'Description' control and declares neither on 'Additional Information', so one bundle carries both directions. The expression arm (Editable bound to a page variable, the issue's own 'InvDiscAmountEditable' shape) is pinned in AlRunner.Tests/DependencyControlDeclaredPropertyTests.cs — see this suite's README for why it cannot be driven end-to-end here.
